title: Side Lights LED 4-Pack – Extra Lights for Trucks
descriptionHtml:
Clear side lights for the truck

Small extra lights make the truck both better looking and more visible in the dark. Missing or broken lights bring down both looks and safety.

Four lights in red, white and yellow

This 4-pack with dual LEDs gives a clear glow in several colors. They are small, durable and easy to mount on trucks and off-road vehicles.

Features

  • 4-pack with dual LEDs
  • Clear glow in several colors
  • Small and durable
  • Easy to mount
  • Great for trucks and off-road vehicles

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
